description: This PHP class 'FormatWithJobCategory' implements 'ValueFormatter' to format a value as a job category name by fetching the category through 'JobCategoryService' based on an ID.

classes.name: FormatWithJobCategory
classes.description: A class that formats a value into a job category name using the JobCategoryService.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the job category name for a given entity value (ID), or null if not found.

methods.name: getJobCategoryService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the JobCategoryService instance used for fetching job categories.
